<h1 align="center">VialFX 1.4.3</h1>

<p align="center"><em>A reworked Morph Random Amplitudes, plus AU for macOS and LV2 for Linux. Free and open source (GPLv3).</em></p>

VialFX is an audio effect plugin (VST3 and CLAP) with a main input and a sidechain input. Each input can be warped, spectrally morphed and routed to the filters, the effects rack or straight to the output.

## Changelog

**New in 1.4.3**

- **Morph Random Amplitudes reworked.** The amount reaches much further and louder, and the pattern holds still while the amount moves (SHUFFLE changes the pattern). MIX and SHUFFLE are equal-size knobs with labelled pills.
- **Dice is a parameter.** It can be automated, modulated and right-clicked like a knob; a click or a value flip rolls a new seed. Presets that automated the old dice may behave differently.

**Also in 1.4.2**

- Audio Unit (AU) for macOS, also in the macOS installer, and LV2 for Linux. Both are lightly tested in real hosts; please report problems.

**Also in 1.4.1**

- Searchable modulation matrix menus, a grouped source menu, and destination sections for every effect type.

**Also in 1.4**

- FX Bins, Parallel Split, 64 host automation slots, up to 32 LFOs, 32 envelopes and 16 randoms, up to 32 copies of every effect, undo/redo.

## Highlights

- **Two inputs, flexible routing.** Main and sidechain lanes with live spectrum displays, each routable to Filter 1, Filter 2, both, the effects, or direct out.
- **Distortion warp and spectral morph,** with drawable spectral modes, a Vocoder, Spectral Gate and Spectral Table.
- **Large effects rack** of fifteen effect types, added in any order, up to 32 copies each, and grouped into bins or parallel paths.
- **Full modulation matrix.** LFOs, envelopes, randoms, macros and MIDI sources can drive nearly everything, now including the points of drawn lines.
- **Skin Editor** with gradients, bevels and glow, and **resizable** to any shape.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows | `VialFX-1.4.3-Windows-Setup.exe` (installer, VST3 and/or CLAP) or the VST3 / CLAP zips |
| macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `VialFX-1.4.3-macOS.pkg` (installer, VST3 and/or CLAP) or the VST3 / CLAP zips |
| Linux | VST3, CLAP and LV2 zips |

The installers put VialFX in the standard system VST3 and CLAP folders. After installing, rescan plugins in your DAW.

> **Note:** the builds are unsigned. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning (More info > Run anyway). On macOS, right-click the installer and choose Open the first time.
